roadmap.goal: Slice 01 (walking skeleton): Cycle-Time percentiles over time. Walk the full backbone — record daily CT-percentile snapshot on refresh (horizons 30/60/90, latest-write-wins per day) -> serve the over-time series via a typed MetricsController GET -> render the 'Percentiles Over Time' widget (CT-30/60/90 toggle, 50/70/85/95 red->green lines, honest empty-state) -> read the trend. Ships the shared forward-only recording pipeline inside this slice (US-02, @infrastructure).
roadmap.overview: Single phase (01), 7 steps in dependency order, mirroring the direct sibling epic-5074 Slice-03 blocked-count-over-time idiom (entity + repo + recorder + endpoint + FE chart + demo backfill). Backbone: 01-01 substrate (entity+repo+DbSet) -> 01-02 migration (both providers) -> 01-03 recording handler (Scenarios 2/3/4/5) -> 01-04 series query + endpoint (Scenario 1 read path) -> 01-05 CT demo backfill (populates the WS chart) -> 01-06 FE widget + registration -> 01-07 E2E walking skeleton (Scenario 1 incl horizon re-plot). RED = RED-by-skip (project convention): executable NUnit/Playwright scenarios authored alongside minimal type skeletons so main always compiles + stays green, each [Ignore("pending — DELIVER (epic-5427)")]; each step un-ignores its scenario and implements to GREEN.

validation.notes: Slice-01-only roadmap. OUT of this roadmap (do NOT implement here): WIA tab (slice 02), ProcessBehaviorSnapshot / PBC widget (slices 03/04), PBC type toggle, Feature-Size, export.

open_questions_resolved.ct_per_horizon_read: RESOLVED at design-read verification: ITeamMetricsService.GetCycleTimePercentilesForTeam(team, startDate, endDate) and IPortfolioMetricsService.GetCycleTimePercentilesForPortfolio(portfolio, startDate, endDate) already exist and return IEnumerable<PercentileValue>. The recorder computes each horizon as-of-today by calling once per horizon with startDate = today.AddDays(-H), endDate = today (H in {30,60,90}). No new service method required; if a genuine gap surfaces during 01-03 RED, add a thin per-horizon read (still EXTEND, no new port). Verify this call path in 01-03 before writing the upsert.
open_questions_resolved.demo_backfill_window: Match the sibling DemoBlockedHistoryBackfillHandler window (HistoryWindowDays = 14). Backdate CT snapshots across a 14-day window for demo connections only; picked in 01-05.

out_of_scope: WIA tab / WIA snapshot recording (slice 02, US-03)
ProcessBehaviorSnapshot entity + repo + ProcessBehaviorRecordingHandler + IProcessBehaviorSeriesQuery + process-behavior-over-time endpoint (slices 03/04)
PBC 'Over Time' widget + metric-type toggle + Feature-Size portfolio-only (slices 03/04, US-04/US-05)
Backfilling REAL historical percentiles (forward-only by design; only demo data is backdated)
Premium gating / RBAC changes (free-tier, ungated — D3)

steps.name: PercentilesOverTimeRecordingHandler — forward-only CT recorder on refresh events
criteria: Handler implements IDomainEventHandler<TeamDataRefreshed> and IDomainEventHandler<PortfolioFeaturesRefreshed>

On refresh, records today's CT percentiles for horizons 30/60/90: for each horizon H it reads the as-of-today CT percentiles and upserts one row per (OwnerId, OwnerType, MetricType=CycleTime, Horizon=H, RecordedAt=today) (milestone-1 Scenario 2)
Same-day re-refresh overwrites in place — exactly one row per (owner, metric, horizon, day), carrying the latest values (Scenario 3)
Forward-only: only today is recorded; no earlier days are fabricated (Scenario 4)

Recording is wrapped in the handler's own try/catch; a failure does not break the refresh path and emits a structured recording-failed Error event with OwnerId, OwnerType, MetricFamily=Percentiles, Exception (Scenario 5; dispatcher swallows errors, so the handler owns its own observability)
Handler registered in Program.cs for both event interfaces; dotnet build zero warnings; dotnet test green; Stryker >= 80% on the handler

VERIFY FIRST (design open question): confirm ITeamMetricsService.GetCycleTimePercentilesForTeam(team, today.AddDays(-H), today) / GetCycleTimePercentilesForPortfolio(...) return the horizon's CT percentiles as-of-today without a bespoke recompute; if a genuine gap, add a thin per-horizon read on the service (still EXTEND, no new port) and note it
